property_summary: Once the contract is initialized, SetMinSum can no longer change MinSum (the reference always reverts and MinSum stays as set before initialization), whereas the mutant accepts any later SetMinSum call and changes MinSum to the fuzzed value.
change_summary: Replace the guard condition `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(false)revert();` so SetMinSum can update MinSum even after initialization.
